Monica / Marissa — quick technical note on subprocessors:

I reviewed the subprocessor CSV. A couple of items to flag before we present to FinEdge:

- DataCache Inc. (row 12) performs caching and indexing and has infra located in eu-west-1 + us-east-1. They also do analytics on derived metadata. Given FinEdge's industry (sensitive analytics), Legal may ask for stronger contractual protections or for us to replace DataCache with an approved partner. I recommend we prepare an "attenuated processing" clause and offer a temporary restriction (no derived analytics on EU-origin data) as a bridge.

- We'll need to include a short Transfer Impact Assessment statement (1 paragraph) to accompany the SCCs. I'll draft language that mirrors our standard Attestation + Controls section.

- One more: retention point — FinEdge asked about 30-day retention for logs. Our standard is 90 days; if FinEdge insists on 30 days for logs only we can accept with a carveout for security investigations. I'll add that option to the redline.

I can drop the TIA paragraph into DPA_Redlines_v3.docx and return by Thursday morning.

Thanks for the patience. Please find attached the updated DPA redline (DPA_Redlines_v3.docx) which includes:
- UK IDTA addendum inserted as Section 7.3 (legal language matched to our standard UK addendum)
- A short Transfer Impact Assessment paragraph under Transfer Mechanisms (new clause 6.4) drafted by Rishi

2) FinEdge Legal confirms the log-retention compromise (30/90 carveout) in writing.
3) Upon (1) and (2) we will issue a DocuSign envelope (signer: Monica Patel; cc: Redwood Legal) — we can set the signing order to require FinEdge exec signature first.

Timeline: We can drop the DocuSign envelope Friday, July 3, to target commercial signature by July 6. If FinEdge needs an accelerated path, we can move to July 2 envelope issuance.
